stories.headline: Valve sets Steam Frame delivery windows: 2026 or 2027
stories.subtitle: Reservation holders now see a December-2026 or 2027 window; Valve also released the headset's CAD files for 3D printing.

stories.headline: Sony sells 419 VR patents to Meta — PSVR3 looks unlikely
stories.subtitle: ZDNet Korea reports 43 patents reassigned June–September; neither company has commented on the December 2025 deal.

stories.headline: Pimax unveils wireless Crystal Pro with foveated streaming
stories.subtitle: Native Foveated Streaming sends the gaze region uncompressed; its 60GHz AirLink claims 6 Gbps and under 2ms latency.

stories.headline: NYC nightclubs are banning smart glasses — and threatening blacklists
stories.subtitle: Venues like Queens' Basement now eject — and may permanently ban — anyone wearing camera glasses.

stories.headline: Xreal opens Aura pre-orders at $1,279 — $20 under Meta's VR Glasses, shipping weeks earlier
stories.subtitle: Xreal's $1,279 Android XR glasses ship in weeks, undercutting Meta's $1,299 VR Glasses (spring 2027).
